title: fp16 weights + DEQUANTIZE -> fp32 folded weights: no effect

measurement.probe: dinov2 85.9/86.6 -> 83.3/89.2 ms (replicated); zipformer 81.6/84.7 -> 84.5/85.0; synthetic twin 9.36 vs 9.35 ms

scope: two real models (ViT-S class, zipformer) + one synthetic pair, both accelerators
notes: QNN folds DEQUANTIZE at compile. The strong static correlation (all DEQ>0 zoo models slow on NPU) was recipe-era confounding, not dtype. Ship fp16 files for size.
